projects.title: Learnin P3K
projects.description: Learnin P3K is an Android-based mobile application created to enhance First Aid (P3K) literacy. This application integrates structured educational content with gamification and quizzes to boost users' motivation and understanding on first aid. This project was developed as a final requirement for a Bachelor's degree at Universitas Pelita Harapan.

projects.title: BrainStore
projects.description: BrainStore is a multiplatform application available on Android and Web, created to resolve customer frustrations regarding low-quality product imagery. The core of the application features a Machine Learning model that automatically detects and flags image quality issues, such as blur ot bokeh, ensuring a high-standard visual experience for users. This empowers sellers to improve their product presentation and boost sales. Recognizing the potential for Machine Learning errors, BrainStore allows admininstrators to review detection and provide corrective feedback through an administrative dashboard for monitoring model performance. These errors will be used for continuous model improvement. BrainStore was developed as a company-based capstone project in collaboration with Braincore during Bangkit Academy 2024 Batch 1. The project was executed by a cross-functional team of 6 members, specializing in Machine Learning, Cloud Computing, and Mobile Development.

projects.title: Pusatara
projects.description: Pusatara is an Android-based mobile application created to address  the significant issue of inadequate awareness and appreciation of traditional Indonesian fabrics like Batik and Songket. The core of the application features a Machine Learning to identify and provide information of the fabric, aiming to preserve and promote Indonesia's rich textile heritage. Pustara was developed as a product-based capstone project in Bangkit Academy 2023 Batch 2. The project was executed by a cross-functional team of 7 members, specializing in Mobile Development, Machine Learning, and UI/UX Design.

projects.title: O-KI (Only K-POP Information)
projects.description: O-KI is a web-based application created for K-popers to easily access various information about their favorite K-pop celebrities. The core of the application features articles and news about K-pop celebrities, also an e-commerce feature to buy album and concert tickets. O-KI was developed as a final project for Perancangan & Pemrograman WEB I course at Universitas Pelita Harapan. This project was collaborated with 4 team members.
